description: This file contains implementation of system tick timer functions for an ARM Cortex R4 microcontroller, including initialization, configuration, and start routines for the system timer, as well as interrupt handling.

methods.name: CortexR4OsTick
methods.description: Interrupt handler for Cortex R4 system tick, clears pending interrupts and calls OsTick.

methods.name: Os_SysTickInit
methods.description: Initializes the system tick timer and installs the ISR.

methods.name: SysTick_Config
methods.description: Configures the system tick timer with specified tick count, setting up registers and prescalers.

methods.name: Os_SysTickStart
methods.description: Starts the system tick timer with a specified period in ticks.
